items.text: pointers for all live subscribers and prune any expired weak_ptrs encountered.
Release bookLock_, then call send() on each collected pointer.

content.text: Thread-safety: acquires bookLock_ for the collection pass only. send() is intentionally called outside the lock to avoid blocking other book sub/unsub/publish paths while I/O is in progress.

Contention: bookLock_ guards only book subscriptions, so this pass no longer competes with account or stream traffic. On high-throughput nodes processing multi-hop payments that touch many offer nodes, it still holds bookLock_ longer than the old per-book BookListeners locks did. This is an accepted trade-off for lock-domain simplicity.
